simple.meaning: נָעִים (nâʻîym) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 13 times across 2 Samuel, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Song of Solomon, beginning at 2 Samuel 1:23. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָעִים (H5273).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נָעִים (nâʻîym) / H5273 is traced through 2 Samuel 1:23, 2 Samuel 23:1, Job 36:11, Psalms 16:6 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative)

firstOccurrence.englishText: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives.

timeline.evidenceText: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives.
Now these are the last words of David.
If they listen and serve him,
The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places.
You will show me the path of life.
Blow the trumpet at the New Moon,
See how good and how pleasant it is
Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good.
For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you,
The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up,
by knowledge the rooms are filled

definitions.short: delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative)
definitions.full: H5273. na 'iym I. נָעִים adjective pleasant, delightful (poetry); — absolute ׳נ Prov 22:18 +; construct נְעִים 2Sam 23:1 plural נְעִמִים Psa 16:6 , נְעִימִם 2Sam 1:23 , נְעִימִים Prov 23:8 ; feminine נְעִמוֺת Psa 16:11 ; — 1 delightful וְהַנּ ׳הַנֶּאֱהָבִים בְּחַיֵּיהֶם 2Sam 1:23 (of Saul and Jonath.); of wealth, וְנ יָקָר ׳הוֺן Prov 24:4 ; words 23:8 ; of acts, etc.: גַּםיָֿחַ֑ד אַחִים שֶׁבֶת וּמַהנּֿ ׳מַהטּֿוֺב Psa 133:1 ; singing praises to ׳י , 135:3 ; 147:1 ; keeping wise teachings Prov 22:18 ; as substantive = delight בַּנְּעִימִים וּשְׁנֵיהֶם בַּטּוֺב יְמֵיהֶם יְכַלּוּ Job 36:11 (of earthly prosperity); of spiritual delights Psa 16:6 ; 16:11 . 2 lovely, beautiful (physically), Song 1:16 (|| יָפֶה ). — Psa 81:3 ; 2Sam 23:1 see II. נָעִים below II. נעם . II. נָעִים adjective perhaps singing, sweetly sounding, musical ; — absolute נ ׳כִּנּוֺר Psa 81:3 sweetly-sounding lyre ; construct, as substantive, יִשׂ זְמִרוֺת ׳נְעִים 2Sam 23:1 Israel's sweet singer of songs (compare Dr 8:10 Löhr ; ᵑ9 egregius psaltes Israel , and so Ges Ew and others, from I. נעם ; joy of the songs of Israel HPS, compare Klo Kit). נעץ (√ of following; Late Hebrew נָעַץ prick, stick or thrust in, wedge in ; נְעַץ ᵑ7 id. ; Late Hebrew נַעֲצוּץ figurative of wicked person ; נַעֲצוּצָא ᵑ7 = Biblical Hebrew).
